entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included when the UE wishes to transmit protocol data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the network. It requires that extended protocol configuration options are supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE includes the extended protocol configuration options IE when it wishes to transmit protocol data to the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network must support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection for this IE to be included.

entities.name: PDN connection
entities.description: The extended protocol configuration options must be supported end-to-end for the PDN connection by both UE and network.
